blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
In logistics, the most-asked question is very simple: "Where is it?" Every day, clients call to check the status of a shipment, a truck, or a pallet.

Today we practise two small questions: Where is and Where are. "Where is" is for one thing. "Where are" is for many things. These questions are the fastest way to check any delivery.

A good rule: never guess. Always check the system first. If you are not sure, say "Let me check and call you back." A clear status makes a happy client. In this job, transparency is better than optimism.

items.q: According to the text, what is the most-asked question in logistics?
items.why: "the most-asked question is very simple: 'Where is it?'"

items.q: When do we use "Where are"?
items.why: "'Where are' is for many things." — plural.

items.q: What should you do if you are not sure of the status?
options: Say "Let me check and call you back."
items.why: "If you are not sure, say 'Let me check and call you back.'"

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with this idea:
options: A clear status makes a happy client.
It is fine to guess if the client is in a hurry.
You should check the system before you answer.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "never guess" e "always check the system". Adivinhar é o oposto do conselho.

items.q: "Transparency is better than optimism" suggests that…
options: clients do not want any information
you should always promise good news
optimism is never useful at work
it is better to say the true status than a nice guess
items.why: Inferência: é melhor dar a verdade (status real) do que uma resposta bonita mas incerta.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily atendendo um cliente ao telefone. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello, this is Emily from the logistics team. How can I help you?

Okay, you want to know where your delivery is. No problem. Can you give me the tracking number, please? Thank you. Let me check the system now.

Right, I can see it here. Your two pallets are on the truck now. The truck is near the city, and the driver is on the road. Good news — the status is "out for delivery."

The update says the boxes are about one hour away. So the delivery is very close now. I am not going to guess the exact minute, but one hour is a safe time.

Is there anything else? No? Perfect. If you have any question later, just call me and I will check the location again. Thank you for your call, and have a good day. Bye now.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Emily ask the client for?
items.why: "Can you give me the tracking number, please?"

items.q: Where are the pallets now?
items.why: "Your two pallets are on the truck now."

items.q: What is the status of the delivery?
items.why: "the status is 'out for delivery.'"

items.q: Why does Emily NOT give the exact minute of arrival?
options: Because she does not want to help
Because she does not want to guess
Because the client did not ask
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "I am not going to guess the exact minute" — prefere um tempo seguro a adivinhar.

items.q: How would you best describe Emily on this call?
items.why: Inferência: ela checa o sistema, dá o status e se oferece para ajudar de novo — é prestativa e clara.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Can you tell me the status of my order?" Status means…
items.why: Status = situação/estado atual da entrega.

items.q: "The location of the truck is near the port." Location means…
items.why: Location = localização, o lugar onde algo está.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Please give me the ___ number so I can find your box."
items.why: Tracking number = número de rastreamento, usado para localizar a entrega.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I have good news. Here is a fresh ___ about your delivery."
items.why: Update = atualização, nova informação sobre o status.

items.q: "What is your order number?" Number here means…
options: a code to identify the order
items.why: Number = número, o código que identifica o pedido.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em ligações e mensagens de entrega. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The order is out for delivery." This means the order is…
options: on the way to the client
items.why: Out for delivery = saiu para entrega, está a caminho do cliente.

items.q: "Let me check on your delivery." To check on something is to…
options: look at how it is going
items.why: Check on = verificar como algo está, dar uma olhada no status.

items.q: "I will call you back in five minutes." To call back means to…
items.why: Call back = ligar de volta mais tarde.

items.q: "Your box will show up in about one hour." To show up means to…
items.why: Show up = aparecer, chegar.

items.q: "Please hold on while I check the system." To hold on means to…
items.why: Hold on = espere um momento, aguarde na linha.
